array.string: mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/vaultchron/logs"; if [ -f "$HOME/.config/vaultchron/env" ]; then set -a; . "$HOME/.config/vaultchron/env"; set +a; fi; PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"; export PATH; exec vaultchron >> "$HOME/.config/vaultchron/logs/vaultchron.log" 2>&1
